prompt: Use case: ui-mockup / production game sprite atlas. Create ONE crisp high-resolution transparent PNG spritesheet for a Chinese hotpot triple-match game. References are STYLE and food-rendering-quality only, do NOT reproduce any UI, tiles or text. The sheet is an EXACT regular 5 columns by 5 rows grid of 25 separate food icons. Square canvas, equal square cells, each ingredient group centered in its own cell, 15% transparent margin on each side, zero overlaps or scattered crumbs crossing cells. No visible grid lines, no labels, no numbers, no tiles, no dishes, no scenery. Real transparent alpha background. Art: premium appetizing semi-realistic 3D food icons, smooth polished material, vivid natural colors, soft upper-left light, consistent three-quarter top view. Harmonious with vermilion wood, cream clay, celadon porcelain and ivory rice-paper themes. Mild stylization, clear silhouettes at 96px, no exaggerated cartoon eyes. Each cell contains exactly its assigned food. Strict ROW-MAJOR positions: row1 col1 Chinese scored pork kidney slices (kidney 腰花), col2 pale ivory aorta strips (aorta 黄喉), col3 curled pale pink duck intestines (duckintestine 鸭肠), col4 two braised chicken feet (chickenfeet 鸡爪), col5 two open green-lipped mussels with orange flesh (mussel 青口贝). Row2: scallop in half shell (scallop 扇贝), abalone in shell (abalone 鲍鱼), white squid rings (squid 鱿鱼圈), three round white fishballs (fishball 鱼丸), golden tofu pouch tied at neck 福袋 (roebag). Row3: golden cubed fish tofu (fishtofu 鱼豆腐), folded flat ivory tofu skin (tofuskin 豆皮), airy rolled crisp golden tofu-skin rolls (bellroll 响铃卷), dark brown wood-ear mushroom cluster (woodear 木耳), fan-shaped oyster mushrooms (oystermushroom 平菇). Row4: thick white king-oyster mushroom slices brown edges (kingoyster 杏鲍菇), white radish rounds (radish 白萝卜), bright orange carrot slices (carrot 胡萝卜), orange pumpkin wedges with green skin (pumpkin 南瓜), pale yellow bamboo-shoot wedges (bambooshoot 竹笋). Row5: pale-green celtuce stem slices (celtuce 莴笋), dark green broccoli florets (broccoli 西兰花), ivory cauliflower florets (cauliflower 花菜), pale taro chunks with tiny lavender speckles (taro 芋头), a neat translucent white glass-noodle nest (vermicelli 粉丝). Preserve exactly this 5x5 order and distinct identities. 2000x2000 or higher square output. Food icons occupy ~70% each cell, consistent scale and clean alpha.
